context_branches.topic: Pre-marked report, mark boundaries and repeated second-level headings
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Learner REPORT from WB21 already carries marks for first/last sections. Level1 selection includes Bold owners; level2 excludes them so generated text differs while body rendering does not. Source permits five levels but guided definition uses two. Step10 repeats Maximizing the Organization and Mail Order Marketing at level2; its guide cites steps7/8, omitting marking step9. Preserve repeat intent and incomplete cross-reference.

context_branches.topic: New first page and contents definition
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Insert page before all existing owners; contents heading and definition precede original report formatting. Define two levels, retain Flush Right with Leader page style. Definition supplies both output location and format; it is not just a document-global setting.

context_branches.topic: Generation confirmation and destructive replacement region
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Generate5 requests tables/indexes/auto-references together; Continue warns existing generated outputs will be replaced and offers a chance to back out. Guided Yes proceeds, progress appears and output is inserted at definition. End Def bounds replaced region; arbitrary text typed inside is lost on regeneration. Indent/Margin Release/Flush Right owners and page labels are generated native content. No refusal/Cancel exact sequence or unchanged-byte witness supplied.

context_branches.topic: Logical page restart, mark new heading and regenerate
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Contents page shifts report start to physical page2. New Page Number1 changes logical status and footer/page references, not physical ordering. Include Endnotes heading and Bold owners as level1; regeneration may be invoked anywhere and replaces contents with new numbers and heading. Editing generated text directly is a temporary change that regeneration discards.

context_branches.topic: Function-key index suggestion versus menu block and later correction
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Mark Text/Index suggests nearest word; Mark-menu Index requires preselected word and has no automatic suggestion. Original step5 removes trailing period from Survival before Enter, then modified heading is also suggested for subheading. WBC51notice141706/91 reduces step5 to Enter only. Keep both editions; neither proves exact selected March behavior.

context_branches.topic: Three survival subentries and second mark on same phrase
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Three survival anchors get heading Survival with economic/industrial/company subheadings; backward and forward search routes retain direction and context. Phrase economic survival also gets an independent heading with no subheading, sharing page with prior economic subentry. Empty-subheading branch either Enter on empty suggestion or delete proposed text then Enter. Native index owner contains selected heading text and anchor location, not a live dependency on visible word spelling.

context_branches.topic: Index location, style alternatives and exterior spacing owner
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Index appended after Endnotes; mark Index heading for contents. Define without concordance using Page Numbers Follow Entries2 among five styles. Generate updates both index and contents. Heading/subheading index differs from five-level ToC. Insert spacing1 outside index definition boundaries so regeneration preserves it; retaining body1.5 inside/outside scope matters. Other numbering styles are visible leads, not executed variants.

context_branches.topic: Native concordance on second editing screen and capacity limits
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: CONCORD is a WP document with Retail and Mail Order each ending Hard Return. Save on screen2 and choose Yes to exit that editor to report. Delete old index definition, define with external CONCORD, then regenerate both outputs. Concordance finds occurrences regardless of manual mark choice, so source warns undesired matches and memory-limited capacity. Missing/wrong-format concordance, memory failure and edits after save remain unobserved.

context_branches.topic: Endnote placement, pending-space comment and generation
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Appending index moves default endnotes after index. Insert Endnote Placement beneath Endnotes heading and decline numbering restart for one set. Initial comment says space undetermined; reveal owner, remove protective extra Hard Page then Generate to recalculate notes, contents and index. Endnotes then appear at placement owner instead of document end. Restart Yes/multiple note sets/cancel/error are pending, not this No branch.

context_branches.topic: Discontinue both footers versus suppress each page
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Source offers Suppress for current page but warns multi-page index needs per-page suppress owners. Guided Footer A/Discontinue and Footer B/Discontinue persist from index start until another corresponding footer. Distinguish both owners and odd/even footer history from deleting footer definitions or suppressing one page.

context_branches.topic: Figure-contained title, Advance and nested attributes
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Full-page figure anchored to new title page actually contains text; contrast prior newsletter border over body text. Inside box Advance Down2.5in, center Very Large main title then move beyond its paired Off owner; subtitle centered Large+Italic. Text is edited through figure editor. No Wrap No selection is specified here; do not inherit newsletter overlay state. Font metrics, page/resource geometry and preview remain unobserved.

context_branches.topic: Four border-side settings and visible unselected styles
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Figure Options/Border Style accepts3 separately for each of left/right/top/bottom to make double border. Double/dashed/thick and independent per-side combinations are visible/prose leads; guided exercise only changes all four to double. Native figure options and box text must remain bound; defaults/cancel/error do not follow from matching border appearance.

context_branches.topic: Document spelling traverses nested texts and generated corrections
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Spell Document covers main text plus footers/footnotes/endnotes/figure boxes when unknown word found; exact misses and responses depend on dictionary and draft. Source instructs correcting ToC marked source text or replacing wrong index mark and regenerating instead of editing generated outputs. Guided Exit closes final word count; individual miss/replacement/skip/add/cancel journeys remain unspecified.

context_branches.topic: Saved report retained with Cancel and printer-resource branch
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Save/replace REPORT, then Cancel keeps it open rather than clears screen; source subsequently selects own printer, preview and full-document print. This Cancel is at post-save exit decision, not proof of cancelling save/generation. Optional review/skip-to-later-lessons/apply-own-documents is pedagogical choice, not source omission or expanded WB25 scope. Native save printer association before later printer selection is retained as ordered action.

context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Primary STORES.WKB provides letter and FIELD positions; secondary CUSTOMER.WKB supplies customer records. Merge begins after both filenames; cursor ends after results, Home/Home/Up finds first, paging visits one letter per customer separated by page break. No recipe/candidate output exists here. Discard result preserves original inputs; saving result is not required for later recomputation.

Address may span lines, so Down within address keeps Field2 while crossing END FIELD moves count. Record counts inferred by last actual record page, excluding trailing page. Source says as many lines/records as wanted but does not qualify memory/file/number limits. Equal field counts/order remain essential; invalid/missing terminators and malformed data need negative probes.
